caption: The drawing consists of a square composition featuring an arrangement of flowers and leaves against a beige or light tan background that resembles a woven or grid pattern. The main objects depicted are large, blooming flowers in shades of pink, purple, and cream, with several flowers of each color distributed symmetrically near the corners and the center. Smaller red flowers are positioned adjacent to the larger blooms, interspersed among the greenery. Additional small violet and yellow flowers are visible in some corners. Green leaves, in varied shades from dark to light, surround and accentuate the flowers throughout the backing of the composition. Silver-gray ornamental architectural elements, which resemble metal scrollwork or partial fence segments, are found in each of the four corners, partially intertwined with the florals and greenery. The overall layout is balanced, with the different floral species, leaf sizes, and colors distributed evenly throughout the drawing.
title: Chair Seat
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
